weakest_scene.root_cause: A generic 'A fits in B N times' machine counted floor(1440/93)=15. The story's actual claim is 16 sunrises a day. The machine takes raw dataset labels and fills neutral tiles with no sun or orbit imagery.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Make the closing show 16 sunrises. Draw 16 small sun-flashes popping one by one around an orbit ring as the ISS laps Earth, next to a single sunrise for the ground. Count up to 16 in the accent colour with readable ink. Data should flinch or shade his eyes at each flash.
